modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organise work as per organisation’s current health, safety and security policies and procedures
report any identified breaches in health, safety, and security policies and procedures to the designated person
identify the risks and hazards associated with work activities, their causes and prevention

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure work area is clean and tidy
ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
sanitize workstation and equipment regularly
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques
identify ways to optimise usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
use resources, including water, in a responsible manner
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines and equipment
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use
identify recyclable and non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated
segregate waste into different categories
dispose non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste

modules.module_title: Prepare for installation of AC system

pcs.pc_description: review the job card and understand work to be carried out to install AC system
identify the vehicle and AC system manufacturer specifications related to the various brand/model/variant
collect appropriate tools, equipment, fittings or materials as required for AC system installation and check their condition/calibration
report the malfunctions if any, in the tools/equipment/material to the person concerned for rectification
take precautions to avoid damage to the vehicle and its components
comply with standard operating procedures for fitment of the AC system in the vehicle as specified by the OEM
make holes/cuts on various surfaces such as metal sheet, plastic, fabric etc., for fitting AC system components and wiring
remove dummy plug or covers and clean surrounding areas prior to installing AC system components
install and fit all AC system component in engine and passenger compartment as specified by OEM
perform refrigerant and wiring circuit connection as specified by the OEM
test pipe or tubing joints or connections for leaks, using pressure gauge or soap-and-water solution
follow SOP to fill unit with specified quantity of refrigerant and PAG oil
ensure all AC system components are installed/fitted/functioning properly
follow standard operating procedure to check the performance of AC system post installation
ensure completeness of tasks assigned before releasing the vehicle
return leftover consumable/parts, tools/equipment, and report if any malfunctions are observed, to the person concerned
dispose off packing wraps/box/covers and other material as per organization’s policies
maintain documentation required on the job regarding the overall process of AC system installation in the vehicle
follow standard operating procedure to identify, validate faults in retrofit AC system and report to supervisor/service advisor if further inspection is required by another specialist

modules.module_title: Prepare for service and repair of Air conditioning System and components

pcs.pc_description: review the job card and understand work to be carried out
identify the auto components related to the various aggregates in the vehicle
check the functioning of air conditioning system
conduct test drive to check vehicle performance and identify/validate the faults related to AC system
conduct visual inspection of the vehicle to identify defects in AC system such as external damage or leakage, wear and tear etc.
determine the whether AC system need servicing/detailed diagnosis for poor performance

park the vehicle on appropriate platform according to nature of job to be performed such as detailed diagnosis, AC system service/performance testing/component replacement, or Refrigerant recovering or refilling
collect workshop tools/measuring device/equipment required for the job and check their condition/calibration
report the malfunctions if any, in the tools/equipment to the person concerned for rectification

modules.module_title: Perform service and repair of Air conditioning System and components

pcs.pc_description: take precautions to avoid damage to the vehicle and its components while working AC system
use workshop tools/measuring devices/equipment required for the job as per OEM Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
diagnose indirect faults in vehicle related to AC system from other vehicle system such as engine cooling system, passenger cabin heater circuit etc.
recover, refill, flush and evacuate air and moisture AC system refrigerant circuit as per OEM SOP
remove components of AC system wherever applicable as per OEM SOP
test refrigerant circuit, wiring circuit and AC system component whenever required
plug the openings of refrigerant circuit joints and place removed components securely as specified by OEM
report the malfunctions/repairs in the vehicle beyond own scope to the concerned person
clean and condition dismantled components, including mechanical and electrical aggregates, prior to assemble as per OEM guidelines
follow SOP to service, repair and overhaul AC system components as per the job requirement
maintain the documentation related to inspection, servicing and repair of the vehicle
check the performance of vehicle/aggregate post repair and report to supervisor/service advisor if further inspection is required by another specialist
ensure completeness of tasks assigned before releasing the vehicle for the next procedure
dispose off materials such as waste oil, scrap of failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation policies
return leftover consumable/parts, tools/equipment to the person concerned and report if any malfunction observed
perform scheduled checks, calibration and timely repairs for workshop tools, equipment and workstations
